text: You shouldn't keep your bread in the refrigerator. Staleness is caused by crystallization of the starch molecules, which occurs faster at cool temperatures.

text: On Earth, we say thank you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: So Leonard, how goes the mimesis?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You know. Mimesis. An action in which the mimic takes on the properties of a specific object or organism. Mimesis.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What the hell are you talking about?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm attempting to communicate with you without my meaning becoming apparent to those around you. Let me try again. Have the indigenous fauna accepted you as one of their own? Nudge, nudge, wink, wink.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Good. Oh, FYI. After I eat my sandwich, I'm taking Koothrappali's Patang kite out for a test run. Would you like to get your delta-wing raptor and join me?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't want to fly kites, Sheldon. We're watching football here.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I can see that. I was providing you with an alternative. A courtesy I was never offered in similar circumstances.
